name: Axe throwing and game venues

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Lane, 1 hour (up to 4 throwers)
services.story: The main story: a lane for 4 for 1 hour, $120 paid in full when booking. A late cancel or no-show keeps $20.

services.name: Birthday party package, 10 throwers
services.story: A birthday party for 10: a $40 deposit when booking, the $160 rest paid at the counter on the day.

services.name: Open lane, 1 hour (2 to 4 throwers)
services.story: An open lane for 2 to 4 throwers: nothing taken, the bill paid at the counter.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Mobile lanes for a company event
services.story: The main story: a company event with 2 lanes for 2 hours, $400. A $100 deposit now, the $300 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE.

services.name: Backyard party, 10 throwers, 2 hours
services.story: A backyard party for 10: $240, a card saved for the $60 late-cancel fee; the crew sends the bill after the party.

services.name: Mobile lane, 1 hour at home
services.story: A 1-hour lane at home for up to 4, paid in full when booking: $120.

services_shape: table: a lane is a space for an hour (up to 4 throwers) or for a set party; each lane holds a set number of throwers per start time
questions_before_times: which lane or party, and the date and time
how many throwers, and each one's age group (adult, 12 to 17, or under 12)
for a party: the expected number of throwers
for a mobile lane: the kind of place (a yard, a company site, a school) and the town
safety_stop: someone hit by an axe, or bleeding, hurt in the head, face or neck, or not breathing right now
first_steps: a waiver for every thrower, signed on the secure page before the visit and good for 12 months; a parent signs for each 12 to 17 year old
the group's final headcount 3 days before (it sets the rest due on a party)
a mobile lane: the customer confirms the flat area, any outlet the crew needs, and any permission the place needs, 3 days before
license: where the state's rules require it: the business's registration, and a permit for the lanes where the state requires one; a mobile lane follows the same rules where they cover it
staff_skills: lane host, party host, mobile lane crew
messages_never: children's names, ages and health answers, and injury details: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
